handbookNote: Alabama Motorcycle Operator Manual (18th Ed., Oct. 2024), based on the national Motorcycle Safety Foundation Motorcycle Operator Manual -- official PDF at alea.gov/sites/default/files/Updated%20ALEA%202024%20Motorcycle%20Manual%20Proof%209.pdf, linked from the official manuals page alea.gov/dps/driver-license/driver-license-manuals. Full text was extracted directly from this PDF (via pdftotext) and used as the sole grounding source for every question, including the manual's Alabama-specific statutory road rules (handlebar height, helmet/footwear law, lane-splitting ban, two-abreast limit, license classes/ages) and its full Three-Wheel Motorcycle Supplement chapter -- price matches this project's established Motorcycle tier ($7.99), not a placeholder. EXAM MECHANICS HEDGED, SAME AS al_driver: the manual itself states only that the knowledge test draws questions from manual content, and does not publish an official item count, passing score, or fee anywhere in its text; a search of alea.gov's driver-license and motorcycle-license pages likewise found no published figure. Five independent third-party DMV test-prep sites (driving-tests.org, zutobi.com, dmv-written-test.com, dmv-permit-test.com, drivingtestsample.com) independently and consistently report a 30-question test requiring 24 correct (80%) to pass -- the same figures reported for AL's separate Class D driver knowledge test -- so this figure should be treated as well-corroborated by convergent third-party sources but NOT government-confirmed verbatim for the motorcycle test specifically, and flagged as such in the EXAM_CONFIGS code comment at wiring time. Content-depth rationale: the manual is substantive (AL-specific licensing/road-rule statutes, full MSF gear/vehicle-control/SEE-strategy/intersection/conspicuity/crash-avoidance/dangerous-surface/mechanical-problem/passenger-cargo/group-riding/alcohol-drug-fatigue chapters, plus a full three-wheel motorcycle and sidecar supplement not present in most other states' manuals) and comfortably supports a large, non-repetitive bank -- 224 questions survive after the build pipeline's exact- and near-duplicate dedup (1 near-duplicate dropped from 225 drafted), all traceable to specific manual sections and page numbers.
